profile_text.body:
NTT DATA is a for-profit company founded in 1988 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. According to its website, it helps clients transform through consulting, industry solutions, business process services, IT modernization and managed services. The company describes its work as spanning strategic consulting to leading-edge technologies, and says it brings a consultative approach and industry expertise to deliver practical and scalable IT solutions intended to help organizations accelerate their digital journeys.

The site also describes NTT DATA Business Solutions as specializing in SAP-centric industry solutions for midmarket and international companies in the lower large enterprise segment, and says it transforms SAP solutions into value for those companies and their people. The company frames its stated aim as enabling experiences that transform organizations, disrupt industries, and shape a better society.
